title: HB 1670 (89R): Relating to a person submitting proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote in Texas.

(section) SECTION 1 (amends Election Code 13.002(a))
(quote) (a) A person desiring to register to vote must submit an application and proof of citizenship as required under Subsection (a-1) to the registrar of the county in which the person resides.
(section) SECTION 1 (adds 13.002(a-1)); text printed with the repeated citation as shown
(quote) (a-1) To the extent permitted by the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (52 U.S.C. Section 20501 et seq.) and Arizona v. Inter Tribal Council of Arizona, Inc., 570 U.S. 1 (2013), , 570 U.S. 1 (2013), the secretary of state shall prescribe rules that require a person to submit to the registrar proof of citizenship to determine voter eligibility.
(section) SECTION 2(a)
(quote) (a) Not later than January 1, 2026, the secretary of state shall request that the federal Election Assistance Commission alter the mail voter registration application form requirements described in the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (52 U.S.C. Section 20501 et seq.) to include a requirement that applicants submit documented proof of citizenship as a condition to registration in Texas.
(note) No documents are named in the bill text; the secretary of state is to prescribe rules.
(other) Sec 1: registration application must come with proof of citizenship; secretary of state rulemaking (13.002).
(other) Sec 2: secretary of state to ask the federal Election Assistance Commission to change the federal mail registration form; attorney general to seek court enforcement if refused within 180 days.
(other) Sec 3: effective date September 1, 2025.
